templates.name: 纯文生MG片头
templates.description: 无参考素材，仅靠文字描述生成完整MG动画片头
templates.description_en: No reference material: a complete MG animation opening generated purely from a text description
templates.prompt:
A sleek motion graphics intro animation for a self-media channel.
Style: clean modern MG animation, bold kinetic typography.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-1s] Dark navy gradient background, ambient particles floating slowly.
[Shot 2] [1-3s] Geometric shapes slide in from left and right, assembling into a logo placeholder.
[Shot 3] [3-5s] Large channel name text slams into center with spring easing, subtle screen shake.
[Shot 4] [5-7s] Supporting tagline fades in below, thin accent lines draw outward horizontally.
[Shot 5] [7-8s] All elements gently scale back, subtle glow, hold on final frame.

Camera: static locked-off, 2D motion graphics depth.
Lighting: soft top light, subtle rim glow on text, flat ambient fill.
Color palette: deep navy background, electric cyan accents, white typography.
Typography: bold sans-serif, heavy weight, wide letter spacing.
Motion feel: snappy, punchy, smooth interpolation.
No human characters, no live action, pure motion graphics.
4K quality, clean edges, professional broadcast intro.

overall_soundscape: Subtle ambient hum, soft whoosh on text slam, gentle particle fizz.

non_diegetic_music: Minimal electronic intro track, punchy synth hit on text reveal, clean and modern.

templates.name: 口播字幕驱动MG片头
templates.description: 根据口播字幕内容自动匹配对应MG画面节奏
templates.description_en: Automatically match the MG visuals to the rhythm of the voice-over subtitles
templates.prompt:
A dynamic motion graphics sequence synced to a voiceover script.

Visual rules:
- Each voiceover line triggers a corresponding visual beat — not just one animation per line.
- Key emphasis phrases get LARGE full-screen typography punch-in.
- Supporting phrases get small floating text cards alongside animated icons.
- Product / concept mentions get simple flat MG icon animations popping in.
- Transitions between segments use smooth slide or fade, no hard cuts.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-2s] Opening: dark background, title text fades in cleanly.
[Shot 2] [2-5s] First key phrase: large typography slams center, accent glow.
[Shot 3] [5-8s] Supporting points: smaller text cards float in from sides, icons animate.
[Shot 4] [8-10s] Brand lockup: channel name centers, glow pulse, hold.

Overall style: clean 2D motion graphics, professional YouTube intro quality.
Typography: bold sans-serif, high contrast, readable at 1080p.
Color scheme: cohesive brand palette, accent color highlights on key words.
Motion rhythm: punchy on emphasis, gentle on supporting text.
No real human footage, pure motion graphics + kinetic typography.
4K sharpness, clean vector edges, broadcast-ready.

overall_soundscape: Subtle UI clicks on text appear, soft whoosh on transitions.

non_diegetic_music: Upbeat electronic background, moderate tempo, clean and professional.

templates.name: 首帧图MG片头
templates.description: 从提供的首帧图开始，往后展开MG动画效果
templates.description_en: Start from the supplied first-frame image and build the MG animation forward from there
templates.prompt:
A motion graphics intro that starts from the provided first frame image.
The opening frame must match the reference image exactly — same composition, same colors, same element positions.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-1s] Hold on the first frame, subtle breathing glow on the main subject.
[Shot 2] [1-3s] Main subject pulses outward, particles fly off from edges, logo scales up slightly.
[Shot 3] [3-5s] Channel name text fades in below, matching the existing visual style.
[Shot 4] [5-6s] Accent lines draw outward, subtle parallax depth, gentle settle.

Style consistency: The entire animation must match the visual language of the first frame — same color palette, same typography feel.
Motion quality: smooth MG animation, clean easing curves, no jitter.
No unexpected elements — everything builds on what's already in the first frame.
4K quality, sharp edges, professional broadcast intro finish.

overall_soundscape: Soft ambient hum, gentle particle shimmer, subtle glow pulse.

non_diegetic_music: Calm ambient electronic track, soft synth pads, elegant and understated.

templates.name: 多素材融合MG片头
templates.description: 将人物头像、产品截图、LOGO等多参考素材有机组织进片头
templates.description_en: Organically weave multiple references - character portraits, product screenshots, logos - into the opening
templates.prompt:
A polished motion graphics intro that integrates multiple reference assets into a cohesive sequence.
All reference images should be treated as placed assets within the MG scene — rounded corners, subtle borders, gentle floating animation.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-2s] Opening transition, geometric shapes sweep across, setting the stage.
[Shot 2] [2-5s] First asset group animates in — clean slide or pop-in, with subtle drop shadow.
[Shot 3] [5-8s] Second asset group transitions in, previous elements slide off to make room.
[Shot 4] [8-10s] Final brand lockup: channel name centers up, accent lines draw outward, hold.

Visual style: premium tech MG animation, consistent shadow and lighting across all assets, unified color grading.
Typography: bold modern sans-serif, matches the brand feel of the assets.
Transitions: smooth crossfade + slide, no jarring cuts.
4K resolution, clean compositing, professional YouTube channel intro quality.

overall_soundscape: Soft swooshes on asset transitions, subtle UI pop on elements appearing.

non_diegetic_music: Corporate tech electronic track, upbeat but professional, moderate tempo.

templates.name: 参考视频风格MG片头
templates.description: 跟随参考视频的节奏和动效结构，替换为自有品牌视觉
templates.description_en: Follow the pacing and motion structure of a reference video, replacing its visuals with your own brand
templates.prompt:
A motion graphics intro that follows the visual language and rhythm of the reference video,
but rebranded with our own assets and color scheme.

Replication rules:
1. KEEP: The camera rhythm, text animation timing, transition style, pacing, and overall structure of the reference video.
2. REPLACE: All text, all brand marks, all color accents — swap in our brand identity.
3. FEEL: The motion energy and timing should match the reference, but the visual identity is 100% ours.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Opening beat] → [text reveal beat] → [secondary element beat] → [brand lockup beat] → [hold ending]
Each beat's timing and animation type should follow the reference video's structure.

Quality: 4K, professional broadcast motion graphics, clean edges, smooth motion.
No stock footage elements — pure MG animation style throughout.

overall_soundscape: Matches reference video's pacing, soft whooshes and UI pops.

non_diegetic_music: Same energy level as reference, but rebranded to our genre.
